name: annual-dac7-report-generation
description: Annual DAC7 XML report generation — generates seller reporting XML for tax authority submission by January 15.
prompt: Generate annual DAC7 XML report for all sellers who exceeded thresholds in the previous calendar year (30+ transactions or €2,000+ consideration). Validate XML against official DAC7 schema. Archive report. COMPLIANCE-REVIEW required before submission to tax authority.
